services.name: Our Yacht
services.desc: Want to picnic on a private yacht? Go to a beach? See local wildlife? Check out local hotspots on the water? or Just have a relaxing cruise around the Orange Beach waterways? We're standing by to make your dream trip a reality. Drop anchor at a secluded sandbar, spot dolphins along the shoreline, or pull up to a waterfront restaurant - your perfect day on the water is entirely up to you. When you want a memorable sunset cruise the Southern Belle is Orange Beach's premier luxury charter. We'll help you create those memories that will last a lifetime. blurb: Southern Belle offers private luxury cruises for groups and families departing from SanRoc Cay Marina in Orange Beach. Guests can enjoy lounging on the bow, flybridge, or spacious cockpit, with a fully air conditioned cabin and two bathrooms on board. Destinations can be recommended or custom tailored, with options for catered lunch or dining at waterfront restaurants.
